description: Final performance optimization pass: configure production-ready compression settings, add resource hints (preconnect, dns-prefetch), optimize font loading, and verify Lighthouse score improvements on deployed Railway instance.
steps: 1. Add Brotli compression support: Install brotli package ('pip install brotli') and add to requirements.txt. Configure COMPRESS_STORAGE in settings.py

2. Optimize font loading in base.html: Ensure font-display:swap is used in Google Fonts URL (already present), add preconnect hints for fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com (already present - verify)
3. Add dns-prefetch hints for external domains: Bootstrap CDN (cdn.jsdelivr.net) already has preconnect - verify all external resources have appropriate hints

4. Configure django-compressor production settings: Set COMPRESS_OUTPUT_DIR='CACHE', COMPRESS_CSS_HASHING_METHOD='content', COMPRESS_OFFLINE_CONTEXT={'STATIC_URL': settings.STATIC_URL}, verify COMPRESS_OFFLINE=True
5. Update deployment documentation: Add step to run 'python manage.py compress' after collectstatic in deployment workflow. Update README.md with performance optimization details.
6. Create performance testing checklist document at .agents/tasks/perf-optimization/performance-checklist.md with before/after Lighthouse scores, optimization applied, and verification steps
7. Test on Railway production URL: Run Lighthouse audit, verify Performance score improved from 25 to 80+, FCP < 1.5s, LCP < 2.5s, TBT < 200ms
acceptance_criteria: All external resource hints (preconnect, dns-prefetch) optimized
Lighthouse Performance score on Railway production URL: 80+ (target 90+)
Core Web Vitals: FCP < 1.5s, LCP < 2.5s, TBT < 200ms
verification: Run full deployment simulation: 'python manage.py collectstatic --noinput && python manage.py compress'
Check staticfiles/CACHE/ contains both .gz and .br files
Deploy to Railway and run Lighthouse audit on production URL
Verify all 55 Django tests still pass: 'python manage.py test'
Manual testing: Visit all major pages, test forms, modals, navigation, verify no regressions
